description: Record where the user is with a job on BirJob: saved, applied, interview, offer, rejected. Use this when the user says they applied, got an interview, an offer or a rejection. Calling it again for the same job replaces the earlier status. Do not use to apply: it records the status for the user only, and does not apply to the job or contact the employer. Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

job_id.description: The job id from search_jobs, or its birjob.com job URL.

status.description: saved (interested), applied, interview, offer or rejected.

name: track_application

created.description: False when the job was tracked already and only its status changed.

title: Track a job application
